Renewal-scrub cohort (nightly Policy Bulk Scrub for last year's customers — see campaign_service.proposal_bulk_scrub_ct) — Quote% over time, same day-on-day/plan-split structure as the main QSR Trends tab, against the scrub base instead of live traffic. No renewal-scrub trend data available.

⏳ This tab is from the last scrub refresh: 18:54 IST, 10 Nov
Cross-insurer root-cause summary — the REAL reason behind each failure, parsed from the insurer's own response body rather than a generic/misleading exception label (e.g. "TATA AIG v2 4W Renewal Fuel Exception" turned out to be 80% "Email ID is Not present in Modify API" and 12% an unrelated failure in our own middleware — neither about fuel). QSR next to each insurer is that insurer/vehicle's actual incumbent-verified quote rate for whichever window is selected below. QSR uptick if fixed = how many percentage points that QSR would rise if this ONE reason were eliminated entirely (count ÷ total scrub base for the same window) — a ceiling estimate, holding everything else constant, not a forecast. Follows the Today/Yesterday/All Days toggle below.

Day-on-day count of renewal-scrub VRNs that failed to get quoted that night (an EVENT count — a VRN that fails one night and self-heals the next is counted once, for that night — same style as the live QSR Errors tab). Quote stage only. Click through to see real error categories (from motor-quote-integration Kibana logs) and the actual logs, each with a "Download Excel" button. A VRN whose scrub never reached the quote-fetch step that night (no quote_id assigned — owned by campaign-service's own external pipeline) shows up honestly as its own category rather than being hidden.

⏳ This tab is from the last scrub refresh: 18:54 IST, 10 Nov
Every real failure reason (same extraction as the Renewal Scrubbing QSR Errors tab) classified into Paytm-side (fixable in our own code/config) vs Insurer-side (their infra or an underwriting decision) vs Unclassified (no Kibana log survived, or a reason not yet triaged). QSR Uptick if Fixed = how many percentage points that insurer/vehicle's QSR would rise if this ONE reason were eliminated entirely for the days shown (count ÷ scrub base for the SAME window, summed across every insurer/vehicle combo this reason affects) — a ceiling estimate, holding everything else constant, not a forecast; it follows the Today/Yesterday/All Days toggle below. Paytm-side rows list the owning component and an exact suggested change where one can be stated with confidence — this is a triage aid from live-log investigation, not a filed ticket; verify with the owning team before shipping any change.
